attempts.summary: Set up a nightly backup pipeline: node1 pulls /srv/inventory/data from node2 over SSH each night via /usr/local/bin/backup-inventory.sh, storing dated tar.gz archives in /var/backups/inventory and pruning to the 7 most recent. Installed via /etc/cron.d/backup-inventory (0 2 * * *, runs as antrieb). Verified retention logic by simulating 8 days of archives and confirming the oldest was pruned. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on both node1 and node2: captured healthy baselines, rebooted each node one at a time, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified full recovery (cron active, SSH connectivity, backup script runs successfully end-to-end, source data intact, retention still enforced at 7 archives) after each restart.
